SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Grace Okafor, MD (fictional)
History: In 2024 Dr. Lucas Alvarez (fictional) removed a 12 mm polyp from the ascending colon with a hot snare at another hospital.
Procedure: I advanced the colonoscope to the cecum. I examined the ascending colon polypectomy scar, which was flat and pale, and took cold
forceps biopsies from it. No polyp was removed today.
Impression: Healed ascending colon polypectomy scar, biopsied.
